Crab Miner and Helmet cards at 3 stars: both cut Hunter costs, and Helmet gives half as much again per star. 3 stars takes 60 Crab Miner cards (about 600,000 Crab Miner kills at 1 in 10,000) and 100 Helmet cards (about 2.5 million Helmet kills at 1 in 25,000) before Drop Quantity and card-chance bonuses.

tables.title: Card rules
rows: Use alts to farm cards in lower zones, and prioritise high-star cards.
The Stump and Pebble cards add woodcutting and mining power; the Watch card adds physical defence (x1.03 per star) before Jotunn.
Each point of Drop Quantity adds 1% to rare-loot chances: the rate is multiplied by (1 + Drop Quantity / 100).
Since a mid-2026 patch there is a separate Rune/Card Drop Chance stat; drops no longer depend on Drop Quantity alone.

Cards needed for 0–4 stars: 1, 8, 24, 60, 360 in Act 1; 1, 12, 48, 100, 600 in Act 2 and for Hard cards; 1, 18, 72, 150, 900 in Act 3. The fourth star needs the Engineer Sun Scroll upgrade 4 Star Cards.
Besides the Hard and Snowman cards, Cactus Mommy, Crab Miner and Helmet are worth taking to 4 stars.
The Act 1 and Act 2 Nightmare cards give nothing yet (confirmed in the 0.323.0 notes).
Killing a boss 30 times gives an achievement that lets you loot 5 chests at once.
One player's rule of thumb in chat: prioritise sacrifice and Hunter work, since cards are more luck.
A monster card drops on 0.01% of kills in Act 1, 0.004% in Act 2 and 0.002% in Act 3. A boss chest gives the boss card half the time.
Crimson Geode (Act 1 veins) and Crimson Sap (Act 1 trees) drop at 1 in 200,000, in Nightmare mode only.
